      The show is now in the final week and tensions in the remains high with the housemates in the final week of the season 11 show. Keivo won the Head of House game earning a spot in the grand finale joining Barry who already booked a spot last week. All remaining 10 housemates faced a possible eviction but were all saved by the Ultimate veto power holder Barry. Here is how the nomination process unfolded.

      Meet the BBNaija 2026 Season 11 Finalists

      Meet the 10 Big Brother Naija 2026 season 11 Show Ya Sef housemates;
      1. Aikou
      2. Barry
      3. Bluethopia
      4. Flora
      5. Keivo
      6. Oyin
      7. Ricky
      8. Sheba
      9. Temi Nkem
      10. Tram

      BBNaija 2026 Final Vote Poll Result and Percentage

      VOTE AGAIN

      You can vote up to 100 times. Click vote again to continue voting. Leave a comment in the comment section and interact with other viewers. Voting is open and closes 6:00PM on Sunday.

      The live eviction show airs this Sunday, where Big Brother will reveal the housemate that will win the Big Brother Naija Season 11 show. Don’t miss a moment of the action—and make sure your vote counts!
